value.rationale: Induced edge matchings are structurally motivated by strong edge-colouring and independent sets of squared line graphs. The canonical Fano incidence graph has rich 336-element geometry, and its strong-matching complex has natural distinct homotopy type from ordinary/perfect/two-matching complexes. The exact 20-sphere integral homotopy classification and full symmetry character provide a complete new benchmark and recoverable representation-theoretic information that the existing strong-colouring and matching-number literature does not provide. A complete finite classification for this natural object is valuable even without a general-family theorem.
